_README: Ranking lenses. Each lens is a named set of weights over the vectors that
build.mjs computes. A lens is a QUESTION, not a verdict — 'which courses
were most fun' and 'which have the best architecture' are different
questions and should stay different lenses rather than collapsing into one
'score'. Weights are relative; build.mjs normalizes them.
Vectors are documented in SPEC.md § Vectors. A weight referencing an
unknown vector is a validation error, not a silent zero.

grint.label: As I ranked them
grint.description: Your own Grint ordering, untouched. The baseline every other lens is compared against.

scoring.label: Where I score well
scoring.description: Average score relative to your overall mean. Null for any layout flagged nine_hole_suspected — a 9-hole 40 is not comparable to an 18-hole 90 and averaging them would rank the short courses easiest.

enjoyment.label: Pure fun
enjoyment.description: Fun score, with a nudge for courses you went back to. Ignores conditioning and difficulty entirely.

revealed.label: Revealed preference
revealed.description: What you actually did rather than what you said. Times played dominates — this is where Rancho Park (ranked 59th, played 10 times) argues with your own list.

conditioning.label: Best kept
conditioning.description: Condition score alone. Useful for deciding where to take someone who notices turf.

underrated.label: Punching above its price
underrated.description: High fun relative to conditioning — courses that are a good time despite the greens. Cobblestone (85.3 fun / 76.9 condition) is the archetype.

architecture.label: Architectural pedigree
architecture.description: Weighted toward external recognition and named architects rather than your own scores. Sparse until facts.json is filled in — coverage is reported by validate.mjs.
